name: Tsubota Mikio
source:
Tsubota is a P.E. teacher at Kisaragi Academy. He’s responsible for physical education and gymnastics in the first grade classes. His attitude is rude, and despite repeated sermons by the principal it doesn’t seem to be improving. Under the pretense of acting strict he treats the students with prejudice when teaching them. Although he’s acting on his own educational philosophy based on forcing others to stay in line, it perpetuates a vicious cycle which is unacceptable to everyone.

[From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Mikio_Tsubota]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
